functions.residue: RESIDUE SHAPE 8 0x24c add r0, sb, #0x18 | mov r1, r8
functions.notes: Only 8 bytes differ. Target recomputes the first FindListEntryById index (x + y*16) with add r1,r6,r5,lsl #4 before add r0,sb,#0x18, while ours reuses r8 (CSE of idx). The form 'x + 1 + (y*16 - 1)' gets SCHED (same instructions, add r0/add r1 swapped) but is a cast-style trick and colorsweep did not fix it. Tried idx type/form variants, li=x-1+y*16, operand orders.
